corrected_defects: An older snapshot could replace a code draft during its save.
A mode change could discard design notes edited during an earlier save.
A code-save retry could report success without another disk write.
verified_behaviors: Code drafts stay visible until their writes have confirmation.
Navigation and window close wait for edits received during a save.
Failed code and recall writes prevent navigation and keep the last draft for retry.
Restart restores the code entered while window close waits for a save.
Concurrent flush requests share one operation and preserve independent draft IDs.
An edit between write completion and promise cleanup starts a new write, including an empty draft.

verified_behaviors: Repeated coding hints, new design attempts, and settings submits produce one request before the service busy event.

verified_behaviors: Settings, recall, and history dialogs contain keyboard focus and prevent background input.
The dialogs restore focus after asynchronous operations without replacing a later focus selection.
Escape and backdrop clicks discard unsaved settings only when no operation is in progress. Pointer drags from the dialog do not close it.
Recall saves complete before Escape closes the dialog. Save failures preserve the answer and permit a retry.
Repeated Escape presses cannot hide a dialog during an operation. Focus stays in the dialog when controls become disabled.
Checkpoint restore errors show in the history dialog. A retry restores the selected checkpoint.
The mouse wheel reaches all 18 checkpoint records in the test. The history header stays visible.
The initial workspace request has an error display and one retry request for concurrent clicks.
A late initial response or error does not replace a newer workspace event. No unhandled promise rejection occurs in these tests.

verified_behaviors: Window close waits for an active hint, preserves code edits during that wait, and restores both after restart.
The last workspace write occurs before window destruction. Write errors preserve the old file and permit a new close request.
Close recovery works from coding, design, settings, and recall. Unsaved settings stay in the form until the user closes it.
A close cancellation failure releases the interface. A later hint and close request work.
The design timer stops during close. The last close check prevents new editor focus and draft changes.
Window close cancels streaming chat and submission approval. A queued chat does not start a model request after close begins.
Stop permits one pending cancellation request for each chat and handles transport errors without an unhandled rejection.
A cancellation request carries the selected chat ID. An old request or error cannot cancel or replace the error state of a different chat.
Provider construction failures release chat state and the service lock. Chat cancellation is unavailable during the last state write, while the service stays busy.
